description: This file manages port-related operations including error handling, port diagnostics, and port usage inspection for a network application. It defines a custom error class, several async functions for port management, and re-exports functions from other modules.

classes.name: PortInUseError
classes.description: Custom error class indicating a port is already in use, with port number and optional details.

methods.name: describePortOwner
methods.description: Asynchronously inspects and returns diagnostics about the current owner of a port, or undefined if none.

methods.name: ensurePortAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a port can be listened on; throws PortInUseError if the port is occupied.

methods.name: handlePortError
methods.description: Handles errors related to port usage, providing user-friendly messages, diagnostics, and process termination.
